title: Code Factory: Proof-by-Sabotage Software Factory
description:
Code Factory catches AI-generated tests that could never fail and turns the result into local, reviewable evidence through Unified Graph Ops, including Mermaid diagrams for bounded proof paths. Existing assurance includes LangGraph resume parity and the Gauntlet Survival Card. Version 0.44.1 adds the current Code Factory product visuals, role-specific use cases for vibe coders, engineers, teams, and enterprises, and a transparent 60-day personal-use case. The observed slice contains 25 Code Factory-related tasks, 133 completed turns, 2,710 command runs, 785 MCP or app calls, and 555 file-change events. A separate counterfactual model estimates 30-110 gross manual-equivalent hours over 60 days after a 50% overlap haircut, or 15-55 hours per month. At an illustrative loaded rate of $75-$150/hour, the modeled gross capacity value is $2,250-$16,500. This is one user's case, not a benchmark, guaranteed ROI, or verified cash saving; net savings must subtract tool cost and human oversight.

Evidence boundary: First Proof is a demonstration, not an assessment of the user's project. Proof Cards summarize one verified receipt and exclude commands, paths, repository names, prompts, logs, and identity. They do not certify production readiness, security, coverage, identity, or release authority.

Case-study visual: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zrk222/code-factory/v0.44.1/docs/assets/marketplace/code-factory-60-day-personal-case-study.png
